newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 vehicle output up 2.6 pct to 1.54 mln.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 vehicle output up 2.6 pct to 1.54 mln.

text.p: China produced 1.5428 million vehicles in 1996, a 2.63 percent increase over the previous year, the Business News said on Thursday.
Passenger car output was up a year-on-year 23.36 percent to 389,200 in 1996, the newspaper said.
Output of buses in 1996 fell a year-on-year 2.43 percent to 205,000 and output of trucks was down 4.45 percent to 686,800.
The newspaper did not give details of other vehicles produced in 1996.
Jilin province in the far northeast was the largest single vehicle producer last year, followed by the city of Shanghai, Sichuan province, Tianjin city and Hubei province, it said.

The newspaper earlier reported that China suffered a vehicle sales slump in 1996 due to over-supply and the trend would likely continue in 1997. Vehicle prices could fall by 10 percent after sharp drops in 1996, the newspaper said.
